description:
Demo pipeline: `fs.glob` → `data.filter` → `data.sort` → `md.table` → `md.concat`.

  Args:
  - `path` / `root` (required)
  - `pattern` (required)
  - `field`, `op`, `value` — optional filter (default: extension eq "ex")
  - `by` — sort field (default `path`)
  - `order` — `asc` or `desc`
  - `columns` — table columns
  - `title` — report heading text
